import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert StichtagDat to datetime
data['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Create a countplot of the most common breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='Rasse1Text', data=data)
plt.title('Most Common Breeds in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Breed')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_breeds.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram of dog ages
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.histplot(data['AlterVHundSort'], bins=20, kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Dog Ages')
plt.xlabel('Age (in years)')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.savefig('output_ages.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of the most common districts
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
data['KreisLang'] = data['KreisLang'].str.lower()
sns.countplot(x='KreisLang', data=data)
plt.title('Most Common Districts in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('District')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_districts.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot of dog age vs. owner age
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='AlterV10Sort', y='AlterVHundSort', data=data)
plt.title('Relationship between Dog Age and Owner Age')
plt.xlabel('Owner Age')
plt.ylabel('Dog Age')
plt.savefig('output_age_relationship.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
